game_concept: A strategy race set in Eldritch Ruins – Ritual Pool, a still ritual pool: the tomb cartographer must handle echo phantoms while practicing lists. Core idea – Mutation Mystery: Spot when two names point to the same list and when copy() is needed.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Ritual Pool: a still ritual pool
core_gameplay_loop: In Ritual Pool, repeat each round: Spot when two names point to the same list and when copy() is needed. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the tomb cartographer ahead. Then check the mutation_safe value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the glyph door by solving code steps involving mutation_safe that move the tomb cartographer forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.95).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the glyph door first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 7 (applied tier): Mutation Mystery
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Mutation Mystery' (Week 7 slot 15), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Ritual Pool'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how mutation_safe changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against echo phantoms in Ritual Pool.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.95).
